Returns.CashInHint: Pounds are paid out at today's rate, rounded down.
Returns.CashOverrideNeedsApproval: Refunding a card or wallet payment in cash needs manager approval.
Returns.CreditAdded: Store credit added. For an exchange, ring up the new items on the Register and pay with store credit.
Returns.CreditNeedsCustomer: Store credit needs a customer on the original sale. Refund to the original payment instead.
Returns.Empty: Look up the original receipt to start a return.
Returns.LoadFailed: Could not load the receipt again. Find it again before refunding.
Returns.OpenShiftForCash: Open a cash drawer shift before giving cash refunds.
Returns.OutsideWindow: This sale is older than the {0}-day return window, so manager approval is required.
Returns.SetQuantity: Set the quantity to return for at least one item.
Returns.StoreFundsHint: Store credit and loyalty points that paid for the sale always go back as credit and points.
Returns.Tip: Tip: find a sale in Sales history and click "Return items".
Returns.Voided: That sale was voided and cannot be returned.
